units_and_criteria_review.finding: The color budget0.2 K and template budget0.17 e apply to RMS differences of postblur outputs between tighter solves. They are neither scientific RMSE limits nor optimizer gradient units.
The primary temperature RMSE is postblur continuum color temperature against full truth-domain labels. It is not latent thermodynamic temperature accuracy; latent comparisons are separately named.

The reported physical gradient is with respect to native normalized latent coordinates (T/1000, log amplitude, species/60, beta), not a derivative per K or per electron. Scaled projected gradients use their route-specific numerical coordinates; cross-route gradient magnitudes are not directly comparable.

The raw weighted RMSE uses observed raw-based Poisson/read/ADC variance. Values near1 are residual diagnostics, not numerical convergence or scientific identification certificates, and no fitted-degree-of-freedom correction is applied.

The four joint profiles pass all endpoint inner references but fail stationarity after stage1. Optimizer ftol success is explicitly insufficient. No threshold relaxation is needed to explain the failed certification.

Both v3 refinements hit400,600,800 iteration limits, then time out in the next stage. The last cached output is objective.last, which may be an unaccepted line-search evaluation. Recorded interstage deltas describe completed stages, not a terminal convergence test.

C1_assessment.classification: bounded inference; not a proved root cause
facts: The frozen continuum LUT is piecewise linear with5 K spacing; its derivative changes at nodes.
v001 caches only T,u,C,predicted_raw_e,valid,low_signal, and omit terminal latent state, beta and profile linear coordinates.
The four profiles have a small output plateau with a persistent projected-gradient floor; v3 has much larger output drift and ongoing objective decreases.
C1_assessment.inference: A consistent C1 calibration adapter is a plausible test of the profile gradient floor. Its success is not established, and it does not remove the spatial/cross-parameter conditioning evident in the v3 formulation.
not_identifiable_from_current_cache: latent temperatures distance to5 K knots
identity of the coordinate attaining terminal projected-gradient maximum
C1_assessment.target_preservation: A C1 interpolant preserves LUT node values but generally changes between-node forward values. It must be versioned and bounded as a calibration approximation; it is not literally the unchanged piecewise-linear mathematical objective.
C1_assessment.adequacy_conclusion: C1 alone cannot be promised sufficient for the two v3 cases. Require actual tighter-output and unchanged stationarity gates under the new version; retain v001 as an uncertified negative result.

single_preconditioner_recommendation.classification: specific implementation proposal; not executed or validated as a solver
single_preconditioner_recommendation.name: coupled Fourier-block preconditioner for free-variable Gauss-Newton steps
single_preconditioner_recommendation.unchanged_physical_objective: 0.5*sum(W*(forward(state,beta)-raw_e)^2)+original periodic nearest-neighbor latent prior; W and prior coefficients remain frozen
single_preconditioner_recommendation.unchanged_bounds: latent T within1200..4500 K, loga within[-4,0.3], active signed species and beta within[-20,20]
single_preconditioner_recommendation.step_system: On the free variables solve (J^T W J + Lambda*L + mu*D) d = -g with actual p.jvp/p.vjp; mu is numerical damping in the step only and is absent from the acceptance objective.
single_preconditioner_recommendation.preconditioner: For the3 active fields use per-frequency3x3 SPD blocks P(k)=G_anchor(k)+diag(lambda)*L(k)+mu*D. G_anchor includes object_OTF(k)^2 and relay-weighted DC and +/-carrier sidebands, retaining T/loga/species cross terms. Invert these tiny blocks by Cholesky/eigendecomposition and apply with FFT. Use an exact3x3 raw-weighted Gram block for beta.
single_preconditioner_recommendation.boundary_handling: Mask bound-active components using the same physical projected-gradient convention; restrict the SPD preconditioner to free variables. Evaluate line-search/trust-region acceptance on the original bounded objective, and retain only accepted states for timeout output.
single_preconditioner_recommendation.why_specific: The existing v3 route only rescales each field by one calibration-anchor diagonal number. It does not invert spectral column correlations or the object-OTF/spatial-prior spectrum. The proxy spectrum recorded above measures the unresolved calibration-anchor spread.
single_preconditioner_recommendation.numerical_receipts: Require recomputed true residual of each step system, accepted objective decrease, unchanged reference-coordinate projected gradient, two successive0.2 K/0.17 e output plateaus, and full parameter/cache receipts; failed linear solves do not become certificates.
